title: Greg LeMond Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Greg LeMond Congressional Gold Medal Act

This bill directs the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for the presentation of a Congressional Gold Medal to Greg LeMond, in recognition of his contributions to the nation as an athlete, activist, role model, and community leader.

summary.headline: Congress directed its leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal presentation to cyclist Greg LeMond.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be presented to Greg LeMond. The medal honors his contributions as an athlete, activist, role model, and community leader. The summary does not describe any money, rules, or services beyond the medal itself.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 4, 2020.
